articles.title: Second Isar Aerospace Spectrum Flight Set for 20 to 23 January
articles.summary:
German launch services provider Isar Aerospace is preparing for the second flight of its two-stage Spectrum rocket, with a Notice to Mariners (NOTMAR) indicating launch opportunities from 20 to 23 January. Isar Aerospace launched its first Spectrum rocket in March 2025 from the Andøya Spaceport in Norway, but it failed less than a minute into […]
